qa_pairs.question: What job parameters can be configured when submitting an interactive application through Open OnDemand?
qa_pairs.answer: When submitting an interactive application through Open OnDemand, you can configure the job's length in hours, the number of cores, the amount of memory to allocate (in GB), and GPU resources. Currently, only the h100_1.10 Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) profile is available, which provides 10GB of memory and 1/8 of the compute power of a full NVIDIA H100 GPU. You also have the option to be notified by email when the job starts.

qa_pairs.question: After submitting an interactive application job in Open OnDemand, how can you monitor its status, connect to it, and terminate it?
qa_pairs.answer: After submitting, you'll be taken to the 'My Interactive Sessions' page where you can monitor the job's status (queued, running, or completed). Once the job is running, click the 'Connect to...' button to launch the application in a new browser tab. If you need terminal access to the node where the application is running, click the button beside 'Host' that starts with `>_`. To terminate the job, click the red 'Cancel' button located in the job panel on the 'My Interactive Sessions' page.
